objective: Audit every explicit Phase C shared-identity completion requirement against live Design evidence; distinguish final/provisional/unresolved/blocked state; identify Design-owned work that can proceed before executable app UI; and select at most one next bounded Design program without reopening closed gates, selecting CLR F2/F1, inventing product semantics, or entering Phase D.

correction_to_prior_readiness_hold.finding: The prior post-APP-SYN readiness audit correctly found that Engineering had not produced representative native assembly and correctly blocked Phase D/WinUI claims, but its global 'remain parked/no new Design gate' conclusion was overbroad.
correction_to_prior_readiness_hold.omitted_authority: The visual-asset materialization roadmap explicitly permits design-master app assets, Character/presence studies, semantic-iconography candidates, material/background/empty-state artwork, and high-fidelity app concepts before executable app UI exists when bounded as design proposals.
correction_to_prior_readiness_hold.effect: The Engineering/runtime hold remains intact; only the inference that all remaining Design work must wait is superseded.

candidate_next_programs.program: IMG-01 — Shared Image / Character Art-Direction Convergence

APP-SYN earned pressure for this gate, but the Director explicitly deferred CLR/context adjudication and did not activate this follow-on gate.

selected_program.name: Shared Image / Character Art-Direction Convergence
selected_program.why_now: The existing corpus is saturated enough that a clean-slate family search would be wrong, but saturation is evidence to synthesize—not evidence that the Phase C requirement is complete. IMG-01 converts existing Stage/hero/VID/Lane-B/visual-grammar evidence into a bounded current cross-surface art-direction and Character-representation system.
selected_program.standing_delegation: Authorized after clean recursive audit as an in-lane Design gate; no consequential family/taste winner is selected by this audit.
